Four merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `doFilterInternal` under `web/src/main/java`. The pinned head is `5eb8cba2` (master), so all four are on the main line.

1. **PR #6680** (TRUNK-6826), merged 2026-10-13 11:03 UTC. Added `TrailingSlashFilter.doFilterInternal`. Merge commit `2d32d20938e007f2f9bf8e3a3c946758d52d6bfe`.
2. **PR #6673** (TRUNK-6824), merged 2026-10-12 10:43 UTC. Added `RepeatedSlashFilter.doFilterInternal`. Merge commit `085d24ca28913de746060914ba4c0305680c9321`.
3. **PR #6544** (TRUNK-6799), merged 2026-10-08 13:44 UTC. Added `OpenmrsSecurityContextFilter.doFilterInternal` and removed `OpenmrsFilter.doFilterInternal` when `OpenmrsFilter.java` was deleted. Merge commit `a69b14a84bf925ff7cdf34e93ca1ffb4f257265f`.
4. **PR #6505** (TRUNK-6705), merged 2026-08-26 17:45 UTC. Changed the `GZIPFilter.doFilterInternal` signature, so both the removed and added lines match. Merge commit `1d0fb13892759020f6bc0824a097518d546024eb`.

Ruled out:
- PR #6555 (`645814dc`) changed `OpenmrsFilter` but not its `doFilterInternal` line.
- PR #6434 (`f39e8f27`) and PR #6598 (`07e8ea06`) changed `web/src/main/java` without touching a `doFilterInternal` line.
- Commits `04a4cea8` and `708c62c6` have no linked PR, so they are direct commits and not counted.

Caveats:
- I checked the diff of every `web/src/main/java` commit since 2026-04-14 on the main line.
- For `a69b14a8` I checked the filter and security directories and the root `WebConfig` and `Listener` files. The security directory diff was too large to read in full. Its files that exist at HEAD are new in that commit, so I found no other removed `doFilterInternal` line there.
